title: Lazy Latin Corn Bake
description: A simple and delicious Latin-inspired corn bake made with lazy ingredients.

ingredients.name: Shredded cheese
ingredients.notes: Monterey Jack or Cheddar work well

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the corn, lazy Latin seasoning, and butter. Mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese evenly over the top of the corn mixture.
Place the dish in the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and season with salt to taste.
